stories.title: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
stories.brief: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

stories.title: Mississippi Democrat flips US Senate seat in stunning upset
stories.brief: In a historic upset, Democrat Scott Colom has won his US Senate race in traditionally conservative Mississippi, networks projected on Wednesday, making him the first African American elected to the chamber from the southern state in more than 140 years.

stories.title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
stories.brief: Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya.

stories.title: Debutant Saqib Khan takes seven as Pakistan restrict Sri Lanka to slender lead
stories.brief: Debutant fast bowler Saqib Khan produced a remarkable seven-wicket haul as Pakistan restricted Sri Lanka to a slender 12-run first-innings lead on the fourth day of the opening Test at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium on Thursday.

stories.title: Pakistan courts global investors at Minerals Investment Forum as provinces outline opportunities
stories.brief: While addressing the forum, Deputy Prime Minister (DPM) and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar highlighted Pakistan's vast mineral resources and efforts to diversify its export base, saying the country stood at a pivotal juncture in its economic journey.

stories.title: Saqib Khan (7-130) rips through Sri Lanka batting in Rawalpindi Test
stories.brief: Young fast bowler Saqib Khan ripped through Sri Lanka's batting line-up on the fourth morning to claim a seven-wicket haul, but the visitors secured a narrow 12-run first-innings lead in the opening Test against Pakistan on Thursday.

stories.title: Police kill wanted TTP commander in Khyber, foil attack in Dera Ismail Khan
stories.brief: Police killed a wanted commander of the banned Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) during an operation in Khyber district, while a separate terrorist attack on a police station in Dera Ismail Khan was foiled following an exchange of fire, police officials said on Thursday.

stories.title: Tarar says dialogue, not force, is way forward
stories.brief: Describing the Indus Waters Treaty as a unique and successful international agreement, the minister said it had remained in force for more than six decades despite wars and tensions between Pakistan and India.

stories.title: Mississippi elects first Black Senator since 1874
stories.brief: Democrat Scott Colom has won Mississippi’s Senate race, becoming the state’s first Black senator since 1874.

stories.title: Nvidia board reportedly deciding whether to oust CEO Jensen Huang as stock price plunges
stories.brief: However, Huang’s position became more tenuous late on Wednesday after it was reported by the New York Times that Huang had a separate extramarital affair with a company employee named Kimberly Powell.

stories.title: Indonesia vice president resigns amid dispute over eligibility
stories.brief: Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of former President Joko Widodo, resigns as court questions his overseas education.

stories.title: 'Summer was a wake-up call, winter could be dire' warning over food supplies
stories.brief: Wales needs to grow more fruit and veg or it will be at the mercy of wars and climate change, one expert says.

stories.title: What we know as pressure builds on embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
stories.brief: The billionaire tech executive's future is in question after reports of a second extramarital affair.

stories.title: Indonesian VP resigns over education qualification row
stories.brief: Indonesia's Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned amid a dispute over his educational qualifications.

stories.title: Significant drop in levels of toxic 'forever' chemicals in England's rivers
stories.brief: The decline has been put down to severe restrictions placed on the substances' use.

stories.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins the closest Senate race in the country
stories.brief: Mississippi hadn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate in more than 40 years.

stories.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
stories.brief: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

stories.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
stories.brief: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.
